wholePhysicalScope: Parks Canada identifies the store at the southwest end of the historic group. The mapped fur trade diorama supplies an estimate of its location and main axis. It is interpreted with the historic two-store group identified by Roy and Drouin and the large shore-side gabled mass in the 1876 Qualla photograph.
lodDetails: All four levels retain the long low gable, paired timber doors and freight landing. The higher levels add door bracing, board lines and handles.
limitations: Parks Canada identifies the trade store in the southwest part of the historic site. This asset uses the mapped diorama as an approximate historical registration and scale reference.
The long unadorned volume and gable proportions are interpreted from the distant 1876 public-domain photograph. Door arrangement, roof covering and grade-adapted sill are estimates.
The original Terrarium field is modern, with a slope across the uphill end. Footing height is adapted to the unchanged source field.
